subject.title: feat(macos): adopt the shared read-only chat transcript cache

question: Should this macOS cache adoption also enable durable offline sends now, or should this PR stay read-only and leave macOS outbox behavior to a separate approved feature path?
rationale: The patch changes macOS from read-only offline browsing to persisted command replay when disconnected, which is a product and privacy/security boundary choice rather than a mechanical cache wiring fix.

options.title: Keep this PR read-only

options.title: Approve macOS outbox now
